description: Notre Dame - Luxury Apartment with Seine View is a self-catering accommodation, located in the 6th of Paris. It features a duplex apartment boasting a modern-style décor, air conditioning and free WiFi access. Notre-Dame de Paris Cathedral can be reached within an 8-minute walk from the apartment.The spaceParis - stay at the heart of the city – L'un de nos meilleurs choix pour Paris.Le Notre Dame - Luxury Apartment with Seine View is a self-catering accommodation, located in the 6th of Paris. It features a duplex apartment boasting a modern-style décor, air conditioning and free WiFi access. Notre-Dame de Paris Cathedral can be reached within an 8-minute walk from the apartment.Featuring a living room with a flat-screen TV and a DVD player, this apartment also includes 2 bathrooms fitted with a walk-in shower or bath. There is a spa bath in one of the bedrooms.The kitchen is fully furnished with 2 refrigerators, oven and stovetop. Meals can be taken on the dining table. Several restaurants, shops and cafés can be found in the surrounding area.
